Test Case 6: Duplicate Detection - 400 if impulse_id Already Exists

Input:
  1. POST /v2/impulses with impulse_id='test-impulse-duplicate-004'
  2. POST /v2/impulses again with same impulse_id

Expected Output:
  status: 400
  error: Impulse already exists
  duplicateDetection: true
